facts.fact: Agence Ivoirienne de Presse reports that Côte d'Ivoire's national information systems security agency ANSSI was created by decree no. 2024-958 of 30 October 2024 to coordinate cybersecurity actions and manage cyber incidents and crises.

systems.country_label: ANSSI (Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information)
